# ORBI artwork

`orbi.svg` is an unchanged copy of the user's **ORBI Pixel Robot Mascot.svg** from Downloads. It is used on the cabin TV and in the full-screen conversation. `cabin-lounge.svg` is a code-drawn spaceship lounge backdrop made for this dialogue scene.

The astronaut's revealed name is defined by `ASTRONAUT_NAME` in `core.js`.
